name: Radiolinja GSM digital mobile service
description: A Finnish GSM cellular network and digital mobile telephone service operated by Radiolinja.

date.basis: Date in the cited source; see scope and caveats.

events.statement: An official call was made over Radiolinja’s GSM network on 1 July 1991.

evidence.supports: Dates the official network call and identifies Nokia as network supplier.

events.caveats: A ceremonial call is not itself proof of mass subscriber access.

contributions.resource: Operated the network used for the call.

evidence.supports: Dates the official network call and identifies Nokia as network supplier.

contributions.resource: Radiolinja ordered its GSM network from Nokia.

evidence.supports: Dates the official network call and identifies Nokia as network supplier.

date.basis: Date in the cited source; see scope and caveats.

events.statement: A Finnish university study dates availability of interim-approved GSM terminals and practical commercial launches to June 1992.

evidence.supports: Distinguishes 1991 opening from availability of approved terminals in June 1992.

events.caveats: The study dates Radiolinja’s network opening to December 1991; operator histories use different definitions of the start of commercial service.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest dated episode supported in the inspected evidence for this scope; no global priority asserted.

research.note: Independent reader checked Ericsson’s 1991 ceremonial-call and Nokia order account; the university PDF for the 1992 launch could not be reopened.
